Question for whoever knows billing: if a customer adds robots mid-month, do they get prorated on the next invoice or charged immediately?

Next invoice. The billing service computes a proration line per robot-day from the activation date, rounded to the cent. Leases and Console seats prorate the same way. Removals credit on the next cycle, never mid-cycle.
